name: 青井阿苏神社
checkpoints: TWO-level romon gate with ONE broad steep thatched hip-and-gable roof and rustic wood ridge ties, not tiled roof.
Three front bays, central opening and two enclosed guardian bays, upper balcony railing, dark lacquered timber with red and green bracket highlights.
Preserve the distinctive sculpted bracket and face ornaments selectively; only gate body and its low base, omit foreground lamps, signs, red neighboring building and foliage.
